data.title: 八重神子 · 冬日围巾的参拜
data.description: 冬日初诣，她难得以普通参拜客的装扮混在人群里，围着围巾在绘马上写字；写的是愿望还是新刊企划，只有狐狸自己知道。
data.action: 冬日初诣，她难得以普通参拜客的装扮混在人群里，围着围巾在绘马上写字
data.promptProse: During a winter shrine visit, Yae Miko bends over an unreadable wooden ema, writing with a brush beneath an amused private smile. Her cream scarf lies over a warm plum kimono, its fringe near the plaque; fox ears tilt into the cold breeze. The medium view places the shrine's timber posts behind her. Winter sunlight reaches the brush tip and scarf, casting her hand's small shadow across the wood.
